description: The Kraft Heinz Company is driving transformation inspired by its purpose, Let's Make Life Delicious, with consumers at the center of everything it does, and with 2025 net sales of approximately $25 billion it is committed to growing its iconic and emerging food and beverage brands on a global scale, leveraging its scale and agility to unleash the full power of Kraft Heinz across a portfolio of eight consumer-driven product platforms. On July 2, 2015, through a series of transactions, it consummated the merger of Kraft Foods Group, Inc. with and into a wholly-owned subsidiary of H.J. Heinz Holding Corporation, at the closing of which Heinz was renamed The Kraft Heinz Company and H. J. Heinz Company changed its name to Kraft Heinz Foods Company, and on September 2, 2025 it announced its intention to separate the company into two independent publicly traded companies.
